text:
Omega has flipped its classic Moonwatch panda colours.

The Moonwatch Professional Black and White has a black dial with white counters, the reverse of the classic panda. It is a 42mm steel watch with a black polished ceramic bezel. Monochrome Watches lists the steel version at about €10,200 with taxes. Our take: a reverse panda is rare on this model, so it is a real choice for Speedmaster fans.

The US price is not confirmed, so we left it out.

Would you pick the reverse panda or the classic?
